title: As Jerry Jones’ 84th birthday nears, Cowboys’ trade for Steelers CB Joey Porter Jr. is a fitting early birthday present

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: As Jerry Jones’ 84th birthday nears, Cowboys’ trade for Steelers CB Joey Porter Jr. is a fitting early birthday present
sources.description: Dallas sits at 1-2 with a need to improve in several areas. But its offense is explosive, and the cost to acquire Porter shouldn’t hurt their immediate window.
